_meta.description: Every perk that has an icon in assets/perks/, including removed (legacy) perks. Keyed by asset folder slug, so an entry's `icon` path is assets/perks/<icon>. Maintained by tools/sync_reference.py; see docs/reference-sync.md before editing by hand.

sources.perks, tiers, effects, removal notes, ti: https://overwatch.weirdgloop.org (hero pages: perk ability boxes + Balance Change Log)

schema.name: perk name as displayed in game
schema.alt_icons: optional: newer art for the same perk, e.g. from the official hero page when the game's icon was redrawn after the wiki's upload. [{icon, source, added}]. Every version is a matching template; old art is kept because screenshots from older patches still show it
schema.tier: minor (level 2) | major (level 3). For current perks, the CURRENT tier; for legacy perks, the tier at removal. Do not trust this for slot validation when tier_swapped is true.
schema.tier_swapped: true if the perk has been both minor and major at different points in time
schema.tier_history: only when tier_swapped: chronological [{date, from, to}] moves, dates are patch dates from the wiki change log
schema.ability: the hero ability the perk modifies. Hand-written for the 11 reference-capture heroes, auto-derived from the effect text for the rest; null if none could be inferred. Informational only.
schema.effect: official in-game description (latest version on the wiki)
schema.patch_era: current = live as of `last_synced` | legacy = removed from the game (screenshots from older patches can still show it)
schema.pick_rate: only on live perks (exactly 4 per hero); the field is absent on legacy perks. See pick_rate_policy
schema.history_note: wiki note on removal / re-addition, or 'Retired (detected by sync <date>)'

_meta.slot_check_policy: HARD RULE of the scoreboard: with two perks, left = major and right = minor; a lone perk is always minor. So the slot tells you each perk's tier AT CAPTURE time, which may differ from `tier` today (tier_history records known moves; screenshots can come from any patch). The parser uses the slot to break ties between perks that share an icon (Lingering/Ravenous Wraith, Phantom Step/Uprush), and reports it as tier_at_capture. When the slot proves a tier this file has no record of, the gap is in this file's tier_history (a patch the wiki change log misses), not in the rule; tools/evaluate.py --tier-gaps lists them.
_meta.pick_rate_policy: Provisional. Values are owperks.com community-reported shares (each minor pair and each major pair sums to 1.0), known to be skewed relative to real lobbies. Use only as a weak tie-break prior. While pick_rate_source is "owperks", the sync keeps exactly the 4 live perks per hero carrying a pick_rate: a newly live perk gets its owperks rate and the perk it displaced loses the field. Set pick_rate_source to "local" once rates are computed from our own parsed screenshots; the sync then stops touching pick_rate entirely.
corrections: Hanzo / Dragon Fury: the wiki ability box still says major, but the change log moved it to minor on 2026-02-10 and owperks lists it as minor. Recorded as minor.
Mercy / Flash Heal (old): the wiki does not flag it as removed, but its effect is now part of Mercy's base kit and it is not a live perk. Recorded as legacy.
jetpack_cat/ulterior_motive.png was previously a generic placeholder icon; replaced with the real 128px icon on 2026-09-22.
_meta.upcoming_changes: Season 5 launches 2026-10-06: Doctrine releases, Sombra moves from Damage to Support with a reworked kit, and Roadhog is reworked. Several current perks for Sombra/Roadhog are expected to become legacy and new ones to appear. Run `python tools/sync_reference.py` after launch.

pending._note: Perks the sync found but could not add to `heroes` yet, keyed by hero slug; `reason` says why (no icon on the wiki yet, or on the wiki but not live on owperks). Regenerated on every sync run, so do not hand-edit.
